Answer-agnostic script at /home/vboxuser/misc-work/solve_tone_fsk_dtmf.py (= mine/solve_tone.py). Pipeline: (1) PIN conventions by re-deriving frag2 and frag3 with my own code. frag2: scanned RIFF metadata tail for base64-of-printable, found exactly 'Ml81dDNAMV8=' -> '2_5t3@1_'. frag3: rendered the 7-row 440*k (880-3520 Hz) spectrogram bitmap over 22.66-24.14s, confirmed it is base64 text 'dV9uMzNkXw==' -> 'u_n33d_'. So a legit decode is base64-of-leetspeak or direct leetspeak text. (3) Tested every mapping the task specified: 2-of-N grid quantization, base-frequency grid, freq->ASCII, band-binary, classic DTMF (L/R/L-R/L+R, Goertzel), AM-envelope demod and Hilbert instantaneous-frequency per burst, AM-rate, pulse-count, duration/gap (Morse). The decoy was printed only in a final CROSS-CHECK block and never fed into any mapping.

result.negative_results: Tone/FSK/DTMF is REFUTED for the 4th fragment; no mapping reproduced '2_f1nd'/'Ml9mMW5k' or any valid base64/leetspeak. Evidence (all from executed script): (a) The 9 fine events are BROADBAND vertical bursts, not pure tones: Hilbert instantaneous-frequency std is 265-544 Hz on 5-14 kHz carriers, and each burst spans ~4-16 kHz in the spectrogram. (b) Per-band tones do NOT quantize to clean levels: LOW sorted 4636,4901,5063,5230,5250,5320,5332,5362,5578 (irregular gaps 12-265 Hz, 5 of 9 pile up at ~5.25-5.36 kHz = a formant region); HIGH sorted 8033,8625,10010,10063,10328,10986,11018,11134,13903 (gaps 32-2769 Hz). No 2-of-N / DTMF-style grid. (c) No base-frequency grid: best B=169 Hz gives mean integer-fit error 0.144, and the 440*k convention (frag3, which fits EXACTLY) gives per-event errors up to 0.47 (mean 0.23) — so carriers are NOT multiples of a base. (d) freq/100 as ASCII -> 'n15o468g?' (last out of range) = gibberish, not leetspeak. (e) Band pattern HI/LO = 100100011 (9 bits) does not group into 6 or 8 symbols. (f) Classic DTMF (697-941/1209-1633) on L,R,L-R,L+R returns nothing (only a spurious '1'); the carriers are far above the DTMF band. (g) AM-envelope rate is ~constant 69-89 Hz (median ~75 Hz) across ALL bursts -> carries no varying data; AM pulse counts (12,21,5,9,21,12,27,22,27) and burst durations (90-359 ms)/gaps are continuous, not a bimodal Morse/dot-dash code. Also re-confirmed ruled-out: downshift (dshift_4400/4800 just relocate broadband noise), L-R (dither only). CONCLUSION: the '...glisten...' hint plus frag3's DRAWN-bitmap convention indicate the 4th fragment is a drawn spectrogram image in 24-34s (the bitmap method = parallel agent's lane), NOT a tone/FSK/DTMF code.
